Bigger Digger

"Same friendship, same philosophy — just more knife."

The Digger grown up — more blade, more handle, same DNA. A hard-use fixed blade built for those who need a little more reach without sacrificing the carry-friendly philosophy that made the original.

The Bigger Digger is the natural evolution of the original Digger — a knife born from the collaboration between StraightLine EDC and designer David C. Andersen. When knife enthusiasts asked for a bit more blade length without giving up the sleek, carry-friendly profile of the original, the answer was clear: scale it up, keep everything that matters.

At 191 mm total length with a 95 mm blade, the Bigger Digger steps into heavier daily tasks while remaining easy to carry, on your belt or in your pocket. The same design philosophy applies: maximize cutting performance, minimize the footprint. Built from 14C28N stonewashed steel at HRC 58–60, it's corrosion-resistant, easy to maintain, and ready for real work.

The Bigger Digger ships with a Kydex sheath equipped with a slim TekLok attachment that works just fine for both vertical and scout carry on your belt but it hasn't lost its pocketability, in fact if you mount an attachment such as an ULTI-CLIP on its sheath, you will be able to carry it in your pocket.
 

Key Features

  • Collaboration with David C. Andersen
  • Compact EDC fixed blade – 3.75" blade, 7.5" total length
  • 14C28N stonewashed steel for durability and corrosion resistance
  • Micarta handle options for optimal grip
  • Kydex sheath with slim TekLok – carry on your belt or use ULTICLIP to carry in pocket
  • Designed for comfort, practicality, and performance
